notes.title: Demo release!
notes.content:
[p]The very first [b]tech demo[/b] of [b]Aetherfall[/b] is here!
This early build is mostly a showcase of our [b]multiplayer combat system[/b] and [b]dynamic interaction mechanics[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Projectiles colliding with projectiles can create elemental fields[/p][/*][*][p]Projectiles passing through fields are transformed[/p][/*][*][p]Dashing through a field triggers special effects such as buffs or powerful AOE damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Melee abilities can destroy or reflect with incoming projectiles[/p][/*][/list][p]While it’s focused mainly on [b]PvP[/b], there are also a few monsters to battle for some [b]PvE action[/b].[/p][p]It’s a [b]very early stage[/b] glimpse into Aetherfall’s foundations — your feedback will help shape where we go next.
Jump in, experiment, and let us know what you think![/p]
